correctness.rationale: For arbitrary p, the neighbor shell has six points; pairwise data-distance forces injectivity; a square-XOR four-color lemma forces opposite edges to agree and hence global edge colors, establishing p affine. The converse checks every possible message-difference Hamming weight. The complete pairwise checker for all 720 column permutations and local square patterns passed; no finite-only extrapolation is used.
